$schema_note: Design variables for GARUN's NSGA-II sizing problem. Bounds match HybridUAVSizingProblem in main.py (xl/xu arrays) -- keep these in sync if either file changes.

variables.label: Battery capacity
variables.notes: Lower bound reflects a minimal electric-assist pack; upper bound is a soft practical ceiling for this MTOW class, not a hard physical limit.

variables.label: Turboshaft / generator rated power
variables.notes: PS1 baseline engine is 60 kW; range allows the optimizer to explore both under- and over-sized generator options.

variables.label: Electric motor rated power
variables.notes: Upper bound set above the observed climb-phase peak power demand (~110 kW at baseline MTOW) so the optimizer can actually size the motor to cover peak bursts rather than assume them away.
